vocabulary.example: In the present simple, the third person singular adds -s: she works.

You can rely on these rules most of the time.

fine_lines.title: say vs say to vs tell
fine_lines.explanation_ar: say وحدها: S = single (المتكلم فقط، بدون شخص بعدها). إذا أردت ذكر الشخص أضف to: say to him. أو استخدم tell: T = two (فاعل ومفعول): tell him. لا تقل I say him.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Say alone: S = single (just the speaker, no person after it). To add the person, use to: say to him. Or use tell: T = two (subject and object): tell him. Never "I say him".

examples.sentence: What did he say to you?

fine_lines.title: no vs not
fine_lines.explanation_ar: no مع الأسماء (no = noun): no money, no one. not مع الأفعال (T = tense): not going, not working, I'm not a good boy.
fine_lines.explanation_en: No goes with nouns (no ↔ noun): no money, no one. Not goes with verbs (t = tense): not going, not working, I'm not a bad student.

examples.sentence: This is not working for me.

expressions.phrase: What did you say to him?
expressions.meaning_en: Asking about words you spoke to a person.
expressions.example: He looks angry. What did you say to him?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking for the information someone gave.
expressions.example: You talked to the doctor. What did he tell you?

expressions.meaning_en: It is not good for me.
expressions.example: This plan doesn't work for me.
You know the rules now. You're good to go.

grammar.title: Rule 1: say (single) / say to, tell (two)
grammar.explanation_ar: say أو said وحدها لكلام شخص واحد. لذكر الشخص الآخر: say + to + الشخص، أو tell + الشخص مباشرة (tell – told).
grammar.explanation_en: Say/said alone is for one person speaking. To mention the other person: say + to + person, or tell + person directly (tell – told).
examples: I say it all the time.
She told me to go home.

grammar.title: Rule 2: third person singular -s
grammar.explanation_ar: في المضارع البسيط نضيف s للفعل مع he/she/it فقط (S = single). مع I/you/we/they لا نضيف s. ومع I نقول I am.
grammar.explanation_en: In the present simple, add -s to the verb only with he/she/it (S = single). With I/you/we/they, no -s. With be: I am.

grammar.title: Rule 3: no + noun, not + verb
grammar.explanation_ar: no قبل الاسم: no food, no one. not بعد الفعل المساعد أو be: I am not / It does not work. لا نقول I no understand؛ نقول I don't understand.
grammar.explanation_en: No before a noun: no food, no one. Not after an auxiliary or be: I am not / It does not work. Don't say "I no understand"; say "I don't understand".
examples: There is no food in the fridge.
This does not work for me.

grammar.title: The 80% idea
grammar.explanation_ar: هذه قواعد سريعة صحيحة في حوالي 80% من الحالات. لكل قاعدة استثناءات تتعلمها لاحقًا.
grammar.explanation_en: These are quick rules that are right about 80% of the time. Every rule has exceptions you can learn later.
examples: Master the basic rule first, then learn the exceptions.

questions.question: What did he ___ you? (person after the verb)
Which subject does NOT take -s in the present simple?

What is an "exception"?
choices: something that doesn't follow the rule
questions.explanation_en: Something that doesn't follow the rule.
